component.name: openEHR Explorer
component.summary: Browse, query, and inspect any openEHR CDR

description.p: A desktop application for browsing, querying, and inspecting openEHR CDR instances such as EHRbase and Better Platform, built as a Postman alternative for openEHR.

ul.li: Save and switch between multiple CDR servers
Browse EHRs and compositions, with a template-aware viewer plus raw JSON and FLAT formats
Inspect Web Template trees and OPT XML
Run AQL queries with autocomplete, tabular results and CSV export
View all HTTP traffic and copy requests as curl

screenshot.caption: The EHR Browser lists EHRs and the compositions of the selected EHR
